dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL on Linux. Uses ORCDBMAIN, MCP-based DB access, and shell dispatch patterns typical of the ORCA system.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system - data check subprogram for receipt billing (ORCBSD01 subsystem)
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCGDSUB02) performs data validation/check processing for the JMA ORCA medical receipt billing system. It deletes system management records (SYSKANRI 3003), manages job control entries, writes a parameter file for a data-check shell script, and dispatches shell jobs (orcbsd01.sh, print_prv.sh) via the MCP database interface. It also handles BLOB import of parameter files and conditional print processing.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (18 copybooks) for modular structure
CALL to ORCDBMAIN for MCP-based database access
Shell script dispatch via SHELLTBL/MCP SHELL function
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (session parameter area) arguments
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses proprietary MCP DB layer)
OPEN/WRITE/CLOSE of sequential parameter file at runtime
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP) decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the archived text. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
